title: Commitment consistency

questions.text: Does the action respect what both sides already promised?

inputs: commitments by both sides with owners, due dates and status

criteria.text: open commitments our side owes are honoured
criteria.guide: The action delivers or advances what we promised, on time.

criteria.text: the buyer's promised actions are not jumped ahead of
criteria.guide: If the buyer promised an internal review, do not act as if it were done.

criteria.text: proposals are not treated as agreed, fulfilled ones not re-promised
criteria.guide: A meeting only we proposed is not booked; a fulfilled commitment is not promised again.

principles: Examples of commitments to respect: customer asked for SOC2 doc before next meeting; rep promised pricing Friday; buyer promised internal review next week.
Catch actions that jump ahead of these commitments.

diagnostics.name: no_mutual_next_step
diagnostics.when: the action breaks the agreed sequence of commitments
